description: Check a UK company on the official Companies House register by company number: name, status (active, dissolved, liquidation), type, incorporation date, registered address, SIC codes, accounts due or overdue, charges, insolvency history and current directors. Use for supplier checks, due diligence, or confirming a business is real and active. Errors: 400 invalid number, 404 not found. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).
name: uk_company_check
title: UK company check (Companies House)
